m6_transfer.revision_diff_and_validity_reason: Original Oct15 Zevlor locked physical 100 SHA d2ea6ed8e42ec512b6a6ae7162da8c17b26494b45a9ff6d0c38882c202a42dc9 differs by exactly six approved swaps from exact M7 100 raw SHA 071e9a8b9eaa0f2cfad65f4e7ef05cc5cf0a8b5f74f2221c75d68e6c4dd1bb8f: Abrade/Terminate/Gamble/Dark Ritual/Portent/Counterspell removed for End of the Hunt/Strategic Betrayal/Gifts Ungiven/Rousing Refrain/Traumatic Critique/Cruelclaw's Heist. Earlier M6 I/J recorded only intake; no Phase B replay or automatic transfer is claimed. All original 5 P0 and 11 P1 IDs were newly modeled and executed in 16 named source-bound tests against the SHA-pinned final 100 and original source, with positive/adverse stack/target/cost/zone checks and six specific added-card tests. The exact 23-method suite and M7 structural/deckwide gates passed dedicated PR #748 at head 4145603e8a13c3470486f9663c15239f247ff3d6 in Actions #40629369955. This is bounded exact-source M7 verification, not a complete Magic engine or retrospective M6.10/M8 milestone.

P0.payable_fixture: Zevlor physically on battlefield with printed haste, untapped, two generic mana available, legal priority; execute {2},{T} and record the single watch.
P0.positive_assertion: The two mana are spent and Zevlor becomes tapped; exactly one same-turn delayed target-copy watch exists.
P0.adversarial_assertion: With only one generic mana, already tapped, absent from battlefield or lacking haste, activation fails; no pending watch.

P0.payable_fixture: One paid Zevlor activation, real Traumatic Critique targeted at own caster, then a separately paid Traumatic Critique targeting one opponent's permanent; conceptual two-target predicate independently rejected.
P0.positive_assertion: Own-target cast leaves watch unconsumed; opponent permanent target is single and creates copies for both other opponents.
P0.adversarial_assertion: A cast targeting our own object or choosing two targets does not qualify; no fabricated two-target Critique spell is cast.

P0.payable_fixture: Paid {2},{T} Zevlor and actual {3}{U} Gifts targeting opponent B, with Sedgemoor Witch and Storm-Kiln Artist present in finite 3-opponent state.
P0.positive_assertion: One original cast and two Zevlor noncast copies produce three cast-or-copy triggers each for Witch and Artist.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Two spell copies do not count as two extra casts; no duplicated cast-only triggers or extra paid original cards.

P0.payable_fixture: Paid Zevlor activation and a cast Praetor's Grasp aimed at B; original countered in response while delayed triggered copy effect remains pending.
P0.positive_assertion: Original enters graveyard and two delayed copied spells still appear on stack for C and D.
P0.adversarial_assertion: Without a paid Zevlor watch, countering the original yields no copies; the countered source does not resolve its own effect.

P0.payable_fixture: Paid Zevlor and BB Cruelclaw's Heist copy for B,C,D in a real three-opponent forty-life fixture without gifting a card.
P0.positive_assertion: No-gift copied hand exile applies to up to three distinct opposing hands but does not change any opponent's life.
P0.adversarial_assertion: At 40 life the three Heist resolutions cannot be asserted as a deterministic auto-win or life damage; empty hands provide no eligible nonland card.

P1.payable_fixture: Original Critique cast with declared X=5, chosen damage mode/target; original Heist separately cast with gift promised or unpromised before copies.
P1.positive_assertion: Copies keep X=5 and mode, plus original Heist gift-promised choice even though a copy itself was not cast.
P1.adversarial_assertion: X=5 without five extra mana is unpayable; an original with gift unpromised cannot become gift-promised in a copy.

P1.payable_fixture: Zevlor equipped with already-cast Bracers; pay one commander activation {2},{T} with two watch effects; separately untap with paid Pemmin and activate again.
P1.positive_assertion: One actual cast Bribery creates two copies per valid watch, four when Bracers created two watches or after two paid activations.
P1.adversarial_assertion: A copied activated ability neither taps/untaps Zevlor again nor creates a phantom new activation cost or delayed watch after the first cast.

P1.payable_fixture: Controlled Twinning Staff, paid Zevlor activation and cast Praetor's Grasp with original target B; three opponents, two other opponent copies.
P1.positive_assertion: One Zevlor copy event creates its two required copies plus exactly one Staff extra; two watches produce six total copies.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Staff-created copies are not new casts and do not recursively grow further Staff or Zevlor copy events.

P1.payable_fixture: Own Zevlor equipped with Swiftfoot Boots has hexproof; pay Minamo's U/T or Seal's 1/T targeting own legendary Zevlor.
P1.positive_assertion: Our own targeted untap remains legal through opposing-target hexproof and makes another paid commander activation available.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Shroud as from Lightning Greaves would prohibit our own Minamo/Seal targeting; untap does not resolve on an illegal target.

P1.payable_fixture: Mana pool 3 generic + B; pay exactly two generic to activate Zevlor, then 1B to cast End of the Hunt targeting B in a legal sorcery window.
P1.positive_assertion: All four mana units are spent; original targets B and two separately created copies target C and D.
P1.adversarial_assertion: If pool has two generic and no black, activation pays but no spell can be cast; no copies or fake unspent-mana refunds.

P1.payable_fixture: Training Grounds pays at least {1} generic for Zevlor; Bracers produces two watches; Pemmin U untap enables one more paid activation; Omen Hawker supplies CU usable only on activations.
P1.positive_assertion: Three actual watches arise after two paid activations, and the named support cards' Oracle texts match paid untap/replacement restrictions.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Omen Hawker CU is NOT unrestricted mana for Rousing Refrain casts and Training Grounds cannot reduce Zevlor's activation below one mana.

P1.payable_fixture: For each actual paid Cruel Ultimatum, Praetor's Grasp, Acquire, Bribery, River's Rebuke and Leadership Vacuum, stage a distinct opponent B as the chosen one-target and other legal opponents C,D.
P1.positive_assertion: Each qualifying cast and paid Zevlor watch yields one resolution opportunity for B,C,D; Cruel Ultimatum deals five life loss to each on success.
P1.adversarial_assertion: If a spell requires an opposing permanent and D controls no legal target, no invalid D copy is created; no phantom object theft.

P1.payable_fixture: Controlled Sedgemoor Witch and Storm-Kiln Artist; pay Zevlor activation and cast one targeted Peek at B, then create two noncast copies.
P1.positive_assertion: Each magecraft permanent observes exactly three cast-or-copy events, making three corresponding triggered abilities.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Only one original cast happens, so spells or abilities with cast-only text cannot claim three original casts.

P1.payable_fixture: Omen Hawker that can legally tap and bears Pemmin's Aura; five finite cycles tap for {C}{U}, spend {U} on Aura to untap.
P1.positive_assertion: A payable five-step bounded loop leaves five generic/colorless mana usable only to activate abilities; no infinite game simulation asserted.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Without Pemmin untap only one tap occurs; with no unrestricted colored mana cannot cast Rousing Refrain or use that restricted pool for spells.

P1.payable_fixture: Pay Zevlor activation during a legal turn, attempt BB Heist in a non-sorcery window, then cast in correct main-phase empty-stack window; separately advance turn with unused watch.
P1.positive_assertion: The properly timed Heist gives two copies to other opponents and consumes the watch; a next-turn Gifts cast produces zero copies from expired ability.
P1.adversarial_assertion: Heist is not an instant and cannot be cast in opponent response window; Zevlor's unused delayed trigger cannot survive turn change.

P1.payable_fixture: Evaluate target legality for exactly one opposing player/permanent target using actual targeted Gifts and any-target Critique source Oracle.
P1.positive_assertion: Exactly one target that is opponent or an opposing permanent qualifies the activation as spelled by Oracle.
